site.title: Moment
site.description: Moment — photographs by Stardust 17 Studio. Morocco, Tokyo and a few still things in between.
site.intro: Nineteen moments, kept quietly — the lanterns, sea wind and snow of Morocco, the rain and night of Tokyo, and a few still things in between.

photos.title: Amber Lattice
photos.alt: A glowing lantern behind a geometric lattice in a dark, green-tinted room

photos.title: Still Life in Orange
photos.alt: Empty bottles and cans on a dark table against a bright orange wall

photos.title: The Last Train of the Year
photos.alt: A conductor in a cap leans out of the door of a cream-and-green train at a station platform

photos.title: Hours in Gold
photos.alt: A large clock and a tall palm tree above a sunlit plaza with long shadows

photos.title: Koutoubia
photos.alt: The Koutoubia minaret in Marrakech glowing warm against a deep blue sky, framed by palm trees

photos.title: Essaouira, Low Tide
photos.alt: The white walled town of Essaouira at sunset above wet sand and tide pools

photos.title: Blue Boats & Gulls
photos.alt: Blue fishing boats crowded below a stone sea fortress as gulls circle in the dusk sky

photos.title: A Quiet Conversation
photos.alt: Two pebbles painted with small veiled faces, standing side by side

photos.title: Souk Lanterns
photos.alt: Colourful stained-glass lanterns hanging in a warmly lit market

photos.title: Night in the Riad
photos.alt: A metal lantern glowing beside a turquoise pool in a riad courtyard at night

photos.title: Red in the Snow
photos.alt: A lone figure in a red cloak standing in a vast snowy plain beneath pale mountains

photos.title: Courtyard, From Above
photos.alt: A tiled riad courtyard seen from above, with carved wooden doors, mirrors and a potted palm

photos.title: The Arch
photos.alt: Black-and-white photograph of a brick archway framing a man, a child and a bird in flight, with another man sitting by the wall

photos.title: Window to the Atlantic

photos.title: Tokyo, After Dark

photos.title: Aperture

photos.title: Blue Hour
